facts.text: Cullimore Hall was built in 1958 and stands at the intersection of Bleeker Street and Summit Street.
Cullimore Hall is named after Dr. Allan R. Cullimore, who led the institution from 1920 to 1949 and transformed the Newark Technical School into the Newark College of Engineering.
The name Newark College of Engineering was adopted in 1930, during Cullimore's time leading the school.
